request.prompt: How much does the Unitree G1 cost?

result.text:
The cost of the Unitree G1 humanoid robot varies significantly depending on the model version, configuration, and where you buy it from:

Base Model (Direct from Unitree): Officially starts at $13,500 USD on Unitree's store. However, this consumer/demonstration version cannot be custom-programmed.

US Resellers and Street Prices: Through domestic distributors, base or upgraded consumer models with local support typically range from $17,990 to nearly $20,000 USD.

G1 EDU Versions (Research Models): The versions meant for developers and researchers—which include full software development kits (SDKs), higher computing power (NVIDIA Orin NX), and options for advanced multi-DOF robotic hands—are quote-only through Unitree's sales team. Reseller configurations for these range anywhere from $43,900 to over $73,000 USD depending on the specific hands and degree-of-freedom upgrades chosen.

Are you looking at the G1 for general interest, or for a specific research/development project?

  * **Base Model (Direct from Unitree):** Officially starts at **$13,500 USD** on Unitree's store. However, this consumer/demonstration version cannot be custom-programmed.   * **US Resellers and Street Prices:** Through domestic distributors, base or upgraded consumer models with local support typically range from **$17,990 to nearly $20,000 USD**. [Unitree G1 Price 2026: From $13,500, EDU Cost & Full Specs - Blog](https://blog.robozaps.com/b/unitree-g1-review#:~:text=*%20The%20Unitree%20G1%20costs%20%2413%2C500%20direct,support%2C%20though%20availability%20fluctuates%20week%20to%20week.)

  * **G1 EDU Versions (Research Models):** The versions meant for developers and researchers—which include full software development kits (SDKs), higher computing power (NVIDIA Orin NX), and options for advanced multi-DOF robotic hands—are quote-only through Unitree's sales team. Reseller configurations for these range anywhere from **$43,900 to over $73,000 USD** depending on the specific hands and degree-of-freedom upgrades chosen.
